title: thornea calcicola
intro: Thornea calcicola, commonly known as 'Mountain Thyme', is a flowering plant species native to New Zealand. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Thornea calcicola include antimicrobial, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it useful for wound healing and soothing digestive issues. Its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, contribute to its therapeutic properties and potential health benefits.
